name: Sprout Charm
desc: A tiny green sprout that wiggles when numbers line up.

name: Honey Charm
desc: A golden drop of honey that never drips.

name: Quince Charm
desc: A shiny little quince with a wise smile.

name: Glass Charm
desc: A clear glass bead that fogs up when it is happy.

name: Gourd Charm
desc: A round gourd that rattles like a tiny drum.

name: Heart Charm
desc: The Greenhouse Heart beats softly inside it.

name: Honey Drop
desc: A sweet drop of honey from Honey Hill.

name: Orchard Seed
desc: A plump seed that wants to grow.

name: Orchard Keeper Badge
desc: Earned by waking all six Grove Temples.

name: Basket Pin
desc: A pin for anyone who helps gather honey.
